title: CONNECT-IP HTTP Datagram Payload Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 IP Proxying HTTP Datagram behavior.
scope: This verification covers IP Proxying HTTP Datagram Context ID and payload layout, 62-bit variable-length Context IDs, dynamic non-zero Context ID allocation, Context ID zero reservation for full IP packets, arbitrary allocation order, per-request reallocation rejection, either-endpoint usability, future registration mechanisms, QUIC DATAGRAM placement after Quarter Stream ID, unknown Context ID drop-or-buffer policy, payload semantics lookup, empty extension payloads, and optimistic HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 client send permission.
preconditions: RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP request and route advertisement support is implemented.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP datagram tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 datagram artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0150-0167 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 IP Proxying HTTP Datagram payload surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
